# `missedPipeableOpportunity`

Suggests using .pipe() for nested function calls

| Property | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Category | Style |
| Default severity | `off` |
| Fixable | Yes |
| Effect versions | v3, v4 |
| Diagnostic codes | `TS377050` |
| Language Service name | `missedPipeableOpportunity` |
| Oxlint name | `effecttsgo/missed-pipeable-opportunity` |

## Preview

```ts
import { identity, Schema } from "effect"

const User = Schema.Struct({ id: Schema.Finite })
export const preview = identity(identity(Schema.decodeEffect(User)({ id: 1 })))
/**
                       ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^ effecttsgo(missed-pipeable-opportunity): This nested call structure has a pipeable form. `Schema.decodeEffect(User)({ id: 1 }).pipe(...)` represents the same call sequence in pipe style and may be easier to read.
*/
```
